title: Why windshield edges fade into black dots
description: A ceramic frit band protects the polyurethane bond from ultraviolet exposure and conceals the mounting zone. Its dot matrix makes the transition into clear glass more gradual.
subtitle: The opaque band and dot matrix are fired ceramic enamel, but they solve different problems at the glass edge.
footer: Conceptual cutaway · not an installation specification · illustration is not to scale

windshield-frit.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: text-free hero illustration for an explanatory windshield infographic. Primary request: Create one refined editorial scientific cutaway of the lower corner of an automotive windshield, viewed almost straight-on. Show a transparent laminated glass pane with its dark opaque ceramic frit band along the outer edge and a visible gradual dot-matrix transition from dense black dots into clear glass. Behind the glass edge, subtly show a simplified dark mounting flange and a continuous bead of polyurethane adhesive, so their relationship is understandable. The center must remain calm and transparent, with the frit transition clearly visible near the bottom and right edge. Style/medium: premium technical editorial illustration, dark navy blueprint background, warm ivory glass highlights, restrained teal and coral accents, fine crisp material edges; elegant but physically plausible. Composition/framing: landscape 1536 by 1024, the windshield corner occupies roughly the right two-thirds, with generous empty negative space on the left for vector labels and callouts. Isolate the object on a genuinely transparent background; no ground plane. Scientific constraints: the black band is a ceramic enamel on the glass surface; dot density decreases gradually toward the transparent viewing area; the adhesive is behind the opaque band. This is a conceptual explanatory cross-section, not an installation drawing. Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, formulas, labels, arrows, logos, borders or watermarks anywhere. Do not depict a person, vehicle interior, dashboard, road or scenery. Preserve actual transparent alpha.

elements.text: The black marks are a functional ceramic coating, not a decorative print.
The dots shrink toward clear glass, making the visual and thermal change less abrupt.
It blocks ultraviolet light before it reaches the polyurethane adhesive.
It conceals the adhesive bead and body flange from normal view.
